value.name: Dicky runs toward the restaurant
value.description: Dicky sprints down the street toward the restaurant, drawing attention from the crowd and a bouncer outside.
evidence: Dicky running down the street toward the restaurant, passing the COSMOPOLITAN CAFE, crowd of people out front, BOUNCER, 6'4", 230 lbs., sirens in the air.

value.name: Bouncer taunts Dicky
value.description: The bouncer blocks Dicky and mocks him, implying he is high on crack.
evidence: BOUNCER (puts his hand up, shakes HIS HEAD) Whoa, spucky teeth, I thought you were smokin' rocks, now you're gargling with 'em?

value.name: Dicky threatens the bouncer
value.description: Dicky mutters a threat in response to the bouncer's taunt.
evidence: DICKY (looks away, mumbles) You're 'bout to lose your breath.

value.name: Dicky assaults the bouncer
value.description: Dicky attacks the bouncer, knocking him down with a punch and jaw hook.
evidence: And Dicky nails the bouncer in the gut, drops him to his knees, wind knocked out of him, then Dicky hooks his jaw... 6'4" guy dropping fast, hitting the sidewalk, sickening thud.
